quests.title: Returns at Macquarie University
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. I am sending back 72 papers a day from Macquarie University and paying to have them collected, which is a business model somebody invented on purpose. This is the third time I have had this conversation. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: the returns stack, at its worst
the distributor needs to see the size of it

quests.title: The Better Rate, Macquarie University
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. They will drop my Macquarie University order if I can show $46 of turnover on the other side of the shop by the first of the month. It started small, the way these things do. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: $46, and cards and stationery count
sell anything, I am not proud

quests.title: The Macquarie University Round
quests.blurb: Right. Since you asked. I do the Macquarie University round from the middle of the news and for the last fortnight somebody has been taking the papers off the front steps behind me. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: the end of the round, where it starts
whoever is on that street at that hour

quests.title: The Dog on Ash Street, Macquarie University
quests.blurb: My knees are gone, so. There is a dog on the Macquarie University round that has had two of my bags and a folding table that was not even mine. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: you will want your wits about you
the owner, not the dog, I am not a monster
tell me it is sorted

quests.title: The Syndicate, Macquarie University
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. Nine of us at Macquarie University have gone in on the same numbers since the first of the month and one of us has stopped putting money in. You will see what I mean the second you get there. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: the house of the one who stopped
$72, which is his share since he stopped

quests.title: The Other Agency, Macquarie University
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. The agency at Macquarie Park closed six months before Macquarie University started struggling, and I would very much like to know what they know. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: the shop is shut, the family is not
whatever they say, say it slowly to me
